description: This Dart source file defines the NewsAppState class, which manages the application state for a news app built with Flutter. It handles initialization, fetching news articles from a network or mock data, managing saved articles, and exposing relevant data and methods to the UI.

classes.name: NewsAppState
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages the application's news data, loading states, errors, and saved articles. It initializes data, fetches news categories, handles mock fallbacks, and provides methods to refresh categories, save, and delete articles.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the app state by loading saved articles and fetching news categories. Uses mock data on failure.

methods.name: articlesFor
methods.description: Returns a list of articles for the given category.

methods.name: topHeadlines
methods.description: Returns the top headlines, limited by a constant count.

methods.name: generalDownList
methods.description: Returns articles in the general category excluding the top headlines.

methods.name: refreshCategory
methods.description: Refreshes the news articles for a specific category, falling back to mock data on error.

methods.name: _fetchCategory
methods.description: Fetches news articles for a category from the repository and updates the state.

methods.name: _useMockForAllCategories
methods.description: Sets mock data for all categories in case of API failure.

methods.name: isSaved
methods.description: Checks if an article with the given headline is saved.

methods.name: saveArticle
methods.description: Saves an article to local database and updates the saved list.

methods.name: deleteSavedByHeadline
methods.description: Removes a saved article by its headline and updates the saved list.
